payload.text: The closing sequence for 0.1.9, which vc writes for hv once ST0002 and ST0003 have landed: quit every Claude session; bin/devbin install and bin/devbin use opt (route C, hv's decision 3); the first ccusage use NAME, ST0003/WP06's adoption, read against its message and doctor; start shells afresh, so that no session reads a profile's own store; ccusage herdr install and hv's check in Herdr (AC-08.3); bin/devbin release 0.1.9; after the publish, brew upgrade ccusage, bin/devbin use brew and T10's version check (ISSUE:0007). Then dc closes ISSUE:0003 and ISSUE:0007, and vc's hold 3 (the tap's CI) is released. The opt step waits for this sequence (hv's decision 4, on dc's advice): until 0.1.9's keg exists use brew refuses the 0.1.8 keg, so every ccusage on hv's machine would be main's unreleased build.
